Talent0_2Ability.name: Unto Death
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: With a Polearm, if unable to retaliate in combat, <buf ID=900008>[Pursuit]</buf> can be triggered, allowing the unit to move <color=#F74848>3</color> tiles toward the attacker after combat. If successful in reaching the target, use the melee weapon to cast <buf ID=900030>[Cleave]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.4x</color> DMG.

100001.name: Mobile Warfare 1
100001.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered. Unable to move before the attack, and this can be effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101102.name: Waltz
101102.describe: Uses Polearm to attack all targets within an <range type=1>I-shaped (3*1 tiles)</range> or L-shaped (3*1 tiles) area in front, dealing <color=#F74848>1x</color> AoE DMG.

101103.name: Shadow of Nightmare
101103.SpecificEffects: For each enemy within an adjacent (<color=#F74848>2</color> tiles) area, Dodge Rate <color=#F74848>+4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>12%</color>.

101104.name: Pillage
101104.describe: Uses Polearm to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.7x</color> DMG. After combat, repairs undamaged parts, restoring HP equal to <color=#F74848>40%</color> of damage dealt.

101105.name: Malevolent
101105.SpecificEffects: When attacking a target in a diagonal direction, Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+8%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.

101106.name: Unending
101106.SpecificEffects: When any part suffers overdamage, trigger <buf ID=900003>[Guts]</buf>, locking to <color=#F74848>1</color> HP. Each time <buf ID=900003>[Guts]</buf> is triggered, <color=#F74848>2</color> AP will be lost.

101107.name: Bloodthirsty
101107.SpecificEffects: When dealing damage, the HP of the undamaged part will be restored after combat, with the repair amount being <color=#F74848>25%</color> of the damage dealt.

101108.name: Disaster Raid
101108.describe: Uses Polearm to attack a target <color=#F74848>2</color> times, each time dealing <color=#F74848>1.1x</color> DMG.

100011.name: Mobile Warfare 2
100011.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

100021.name: Mobile Warfare 3
100021.SpecificEffects: Destroying the target can trigger <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>, allowing action with full movement distance.

100022.name: Power Innovation 2
100022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

100031.name: Alacrity 1
100031.SpecificEffects: During an Active Attack with a Melee Weapon, there is a <color=#F74848>20%</color> chance to trigger <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> following the enemy’s attack, dealing <color=#F74848>0.5x</color> DMG.

100033.name: Mobile Warfare 4
100033.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> or <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

100034.name: Alacrity 2
100034.SpecificEffects: Before an Active Attack, the probability of triggering <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> increases by <color=#F74848>6%</color> for each <color=#F74848>1</color> tile moved, up to <color=#F74848>30%</color>.

100035.name: Alacrity 3
100035.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.75</color>.

100036.name: Alacrity 4
100036.SpecificEffects: When triggering <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf>, prioritize hitting the part with the lowest HP.

101141.name: The Ominous 1
101141.SpecificEffects: Increase the movement distance of <buf ID=900008>[Pursuit]</buf> to <color=#F74848>4</color> tiles.

100043.name: Power Innovation 3
100043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101144.name: The Ominous 2
101144.SpecificEffects: When failing to move to the attacker's side with <buf ID=900008>[Pursuit]</buf>, automatically search for other targets within an adjacent (<color=#F74848>1</color> tile) area to cast <buf ID=900030>[Cleave]</buf>.

101145.name: The Ominous 3
101145.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Polearm, deal [Collateral DMG] to <color=#F74848>1</color> additional part for <color=#F74848>15%</color> of the damage dealt.

101146.name: The Ominous 4
101146.SpecificEffects: The multiplier of Collateral DMG is increased to <color=#F74848>40%</color> of the damage dealt.
